description: Source code implementing the google_breakpad::ElfCoreDump class and its nested Note class, handling ELF core dump parsing and validation.

classes.name: ElfCoreDump
classes.description: Represents an ELF core dump, providing methods to validate, access headers, program headers, and notes.

classes.name: ElfCoreDump::Note
classes.description: Represents a note within the ELF core dump, providing access to header, type, name, description, and navigation to next note.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::Note::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the note has a valid header.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::Note::GetName
methods.description: Returns the name part of the note.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::Note::GetDescription
methods.description: Returns the description part of the note.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::Note::GetNextNote
methods.description: Returns the next note in the sequence.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::Note::AlignedSize
methods.description: Calculates aligned size for note data.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::SetContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the ELF dump.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::IsValid
methods.description: Validates ELF header to confirm ELF core dump.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::GetProgramHeader
methods.description: Returns program header at specified index.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::GetFirstProgramHeaderOfType
methods.description: Finds first program header of specified type.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::CopyData
methods.description: Copies data from virtual address to buffer.

methods.name: ElfCoreDump::GetFirstNote
methods.description: Returns the first note in the ELF core dump.
